name: Capture
description:
You throw an empty Vessel at a non-humanoid creature within medium range. Roll Awe, Spirit, or Persuade. If the creature’s current Endurance is less than half its maximum, the roll is favored.

  • On a result below the creature’s Challenge score, the Vessel bursts.

  • On a result equal to or greater than its Challenge score: subtract the roll result from the Challenge score. The remainder is the XP cost to capture the creature. If you do not pay this cost, the Vessel bursts.

When you capture a creature, also apply the following based on the skill you used:

  • Awe: Mark BODY; the creature gains 1 Friendship.

  • Spirit: Mark HEART; the creature gains 2 Friendship.

  • Persuade: Mark WITS; the creature gains 3 Friendship.

Skills under the marked core ability cost double the normal amount of XP to increase for that creature.

Describe how you attempt to capture the creature.
successes:
✨: The creature costs 1 less XP to capture.

🌞: The creature costs 5 less XP to capture and gains an additional 1 Friendship on a capture.

💀: If you capture the creature, it has 0 levels of friendship. If you do not capture the creature, its attack rolls against you are favored for the next minute.
